summary: Plan-document update wave and governance seal for the 2026-08-13 PMConcept7 workspace repair. The rebuilt artifact (assemble-then-repin base de297808 plus the T20 overhaul, output sha256 28f69e75) makes floating explicit-only (window exit is invalid_target; Pop Out rows on editor panels, Chat and Dashboard; boot demotes persisted floating to last_docked_host with a storage.boot_demote_floating receipt), retires the base full-screen chat overlay for a single in-canvas float system, adds footprint-true change-gated drop previews with host caps, adjacent-pair pixel resize with fair-share minimums and a render-time no-dead-space invariant, the 28x28 top-left corner triangle grip, the dual-surface Reset Layout row, all-pane editor tab reorder persistence with the portal-family overflow chip, the frosted translucent tab rail with masked shoulder cutouts, and returns the title-bar notification stack between the page tabs and the search (deliberate dated revert of the 2026-08-12 placement). Owner docs were amended with explicit dated stale/retired dispositions wherever prior canon was reversed (F3-460 placement, F3-502/F3-HOME-003 reset prohibition, F3-HOME-002 window-exit floating); the production census grew 51 to 55 home rows. Command, event, receipt, schema and storage contracts are unchanged and no new command IDs were minted. checks.details: Four harness-surfaced defects were fixed and the artifact rebuilt within this wave, with no canon change required (the amendments already specify the intended behaviors): D1 spring preservation (a re-render no longer replaces the silhouette's selection spring with a snap), D2 float-layer hijack exclusion (float-layer surfaces are excluded from the base layer's geometry hijack paths), D3 host caps enforced on the keyboard and API move paths with normalization spilling overflow to home_main, and D4 grip z-order raised over row handles so the corner triangle wins the hit test. A final D5 fix followed: the capture-phase window blur listener cancelled a drag begun on a focused grip (the grip's element blur passed through capture phase); it is now guarded with event.target !== window so only a true window blur cancels.
